topics.purpose: Define reusable machine-significant value types with exact validation, representation and compatibility semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable semantic value type has explicit identity.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Type compatibility/coercion is explicit and never guessed from similar representation.
semantics.null_rule: Null/absent semantics are separate from type unless explicitly included.
semantics.unit_rule: Unit-bearing values reference exact unit semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Type compatibility grants no resource authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: type name used as field identity
